sourceLayer.untwistedOperators: for every Leech minimal vector alpha of norm four, u_alpha=e^alpha+e^-alpha is an inversion-even weight-two state
sourceLayer.twistedAction: the class alpha mod 2Lambda acts on the twisted ground module through the extraspecial central extension

injectivity.statement: if norm-four alpha and beta have the same class modulo 2Lambda, then beta equals plus or minus alpha
injectivity.proof: lambda=(alpha-beta)/2 lies in Lambda and lambda squared=2-(alpha dot beta)/2; Leech minimum norm four plus Cauchy forces lambda=0 or alpha dot beta=-4, the latter giving beta=-alpha

executableCompiler.choice: the 24 basis vectors of the explicit Gram matrix, each of norm four
executableCompiler.map: reduce the basis vector mod 2 and apply S inverse to obtain its canonical twelve-qubit (X|Z) Pauli label
checks: all 24 Pauli labels are nonzero and independent
their Pauli commutators reproduce K modulo 2
every nonidentity marked Pauli has zero twisted-ground trace
the compiled catalogue Clifford generators conjugate labels exactly as the Leech automorphisms act modulo 2

promotion.established: a concrete covariant map from 24 marked untwisted minimal-vector operators to Pauli actions on the twisted ground module, extending abstract sector joining to noncentral operators
promotion.open: the lift through the half-oscillator projection to the retained weight-two twisted sector, the absolute OPE normalization, the remaining 98256 minimal-pair operators as an enumerated hardware dictionary, the 300 oscillator-bilinear actions, and full Griess multiplication

boundary: This is a source-backed representation action of untwisted vertex operators on the pre-projection twisted ground module. The verifier certifies the integral/mod-2 labels and covariance, while the VOA source supplies that these labels act through the twisted central extension. Lifting the action to the retained weight-two half-mode states is separate.
